_comment: Cross-request same-die pairing probe, mismatch instrument (issue #244 AC 4c).
Seed 244, seed_scope shared, vary mismatch: sample k's mc_seed must equal
evidence-s1-mismatch/report.json's mc<k> at Vctrl=0.0, bit for bit. If these four
units do not reproduce anchor-1's first four dies, the S2 requests must carry
all six Vctrl points instead of reusing the S1 endpoints.

measurements.name: t_cross_1
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_1 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=1 TD=10n

measurements.name: t_cross_11
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_11 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=11 TD=10n

measurements.name: vdiff_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_max MAX v(vdiff) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_min MIN v(vdiff) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_late_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_late_max MAX v(vdiff) FROM=15n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_late_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_late_min MIN v(vdiff) FROM=15n TO=20n

measurements.name: isup_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran isup_avg AVG i(vsup) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vtail_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran vtail_avg AVG v(tail) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vte_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran vte_avg AVG v(te) FROM=10n TO=20n
